title: nbn 500/50 $59.99/M for 6-Months Then $77.99/M for 18-Months, eero 7 Router $0 if You Stay for 24-Months + $10 Delivery @ Arctel
body:
Deal: nbn 500/50 $59.99/M for 6-Months Then $77.99/M for 18-Months, eero 7 Router $0 if You Stay for 24-Months + $10 Delivery @ Arctel

[belongsinforums] early termination will result in a payout of the eero.
bad deal
[Team Triforce] Pay for the eero 7 upfront, we are still cheaper on the device than anyone online? No bargain left if the business is closed.
Find a better deal, over 24-Months, with a router…
[belongsinforums] better deal is easily dodo at $60 p/m with $120 cashback after 3 months, no lock-in
[OZKap] also Amaysi $50/m for 6 months 500/50, no lock in, but some people have reported connection issues, high ping etc.
Been flawless for me
[OZKap] What kind of person locks themselves in to a 24 month plan at $80/m when we can reliably churn to get $50-60/m for 6 months at a time.
eero 7 at JB $300
18 months x $20 = 360
[Team Triforce] You’re also not locked in… we are freezing the price, you can leave at any time & pay a pro-rata fee for the eero. We are simply locking it in, in 2027 & 2028, providers might increase prices by $10 each year, then all that maths below changes again.
For your reference, wholesale cost on NBN 500/50 is over $60 ex. GST the market price will eventually move & people who are not locked in will have to move to what is then available in market.
When the variable interest rate was low, nobody locked in. Once they started to rise, the people paying a small premium on the fixed rates all had the final laugh.
These plans are not for everyone, personally moving providers every 6 months & paying cash upfront for a router, to save $23 is a waste of time in my eyes, you may disagree & I respect that.
[cook99] @Team Triforce: Can I do this deal for 6 months without a router then leave?
[cook99] @Team Triforce: Thanks, no deal for me but hopefully helps someone.
[HansW] @Team Triforce: What do you mean No? Your website literally lets you check out with any plan with the no modem for $0 option.
[OZKap] @Team Triforce:
moving providers every 6 months & paying cash upfront for a router
Router was provided for free when i had NBN installed (also free), i think it was a 6 month contract?
Dunno what you're doing to your routers, but I haven't needed a replacement.
[Team Triforce] @OZKap: Care to share the brand & model?
[OZKap] @Team Triforce: VX420-G2h
AX5400 Hybrid Wi-Fi 6 Modem Router with VoIP
https://www.tp-link.com/au/service-provider/xdsl/vx420-g2h/
It's letting me use full 500mbps via wifi, covers the house and a little ways outside.
[Team Triforce] Hmm…
24 x $60 = $1,440 + $300 (eero 7)
6 x $60 = $360, plus 18 x $77.99 = $1,403.82 [Total = 1,763.82]
If $23.82 is worth your time changing providers, driving or ordering from JB & missing out on your chance to win in our monthly giveaways, you are more committed to saving a few dollars than me!
[HansW] I can’t find this deal. It’s either 6 12 or 24 months plans.
[crackman] can i move to this if i joined the $79 per month plan fo 2 years?
[Team Triforce] DM me your service ID & we will come back to you with something.
[michael9865] Is it just one eero 7, or is it a pack of 3 as need it a pack for around the house
[Team Triforce] Single eero 7, you can pick a pack of 3, but only one will be included for free, the other two you will need to pay for.
[michael9865] If you upgrade to a single eero pro 7, i will sign up
[Team Triforce] Sorry mate, we only supply the eero 7, the Pro 7 is already double the price… so imagine the abuse I would cop on here!
[michael9865] @Team Triforce: No problem, eero 7 is currently $270 with black friday approaching i expect it to go under $200
7 pro is $350, waiting for it to go under $300 to buy
[Team Triforce] @michael9865: @michael9865 - Will be very interesting! Next model has not been confirmed yet, with all the chip / component shortages…. Not sure if they will dump their excess stock, as they have in the past.
I agree with you though, very possible. Even then, if you sign up we are selling the eero 7 for $149! So its still cheaper, even if you just stay for a month…
[ysco] I don't see this deal on your website. For me it shows $59.99/month for 6 months, then $84.99 ongoing
[Goonda] Ive been with Arctel for over 6 months and been very happy with the service and speed. On a 1000 mps plan.
[wheels4000] Surprising. I was with Arctel for a few months and yeah, was terrible, but you and I probably have different usage habits/use cases. (We're both in QLD)
[AppleSmack] Im with Arctel too, and to date, its been flawless. Speeds max out 24/7, flawless support after midnight (Bloody brilliant), grabbed a static IP for a few things I needed, low ping for gaming, so no problems here. Plus the couple of people i referred are pleasantly pleased too.
[wheels4000] Yeaaaaa alright, not in my experience at all.
[Winny182] Market leading short term incentives
amaysim kinda have you beat
[Tanvry] Optus is even better with the cashback / finder gift card deal if you stay for 6 months it becomes like mid 30s-40s
[Winny182] Excluded that because extra steps and some people have bad experiences with Finder paying out. None the less there are numerous far better short term deals available
[CacheHunter] How is this market leading? For those areas with access to vision network, Vodafone is currently offering 500/50 for $30/m. I switched and was pleased that I'm actually getting 950/110 during the evening peak
[OZKap] Powerful 500Mbps fibre internet for $30/mth
For a year, plus your first month on us.
New connections at Vision premises only. First month on us available until withdrawn. Price offer ends 20/01/27 (unless extended).
https://www.vodafone.com.au/home-internet/vision
[AppleSmack] So your getting 950 on a 500 connection, yeah right.
Plus, anything thats not Vodafone is market leading.
[E4xtream] Essentially using the router to soft lock people into the deal. Considering the router is not something everyone would want, this is pretty sleazy.
[HansW] You don’t have to choose the option. The website lets you check out with a $0 no modem option.
[Team Triforce] Did the maths above, it’s the cheapest way to buy a router if you want / need one 👍🏽
[thedavemiester] Coming up to my 12 month anniversary with arctel and although no real issue I'm disappointed that we're still waiting for the Brisbane pop
[Team Triforce] @thedavemiester - Warranted, it has definitely takes us longer to deliver on the QLD POP than it should. Can you drop me your service ID in a DM? Will reach out.
[dealhunter-007] Is it on CGNAT?
If yes, is opt out free?
[Team Triforce] Yes it’s CG-NAT, unfortunately no Opt-Out at this stage… so you have to pay for a static IP ($5 p/Month).
[dreamzz] Does the eero comes with premium subscription like superloop?
